scope_summary: Replaced the individual product card grid (30 cards) with a design-first grid (11 design cards). Each design card shows the artwork and a product count. Clicking opens an accessible modal where the user picks their product type and price, then taps a buy button. Removed Low Stim Mode design. Added 5 previously unused designs: Brains That Zig, Chaos Goblin, Sidequest, Tabs Open, Tinfoil Mode. No filter bar (modal replaces it). All buy buttons remain href='#' placeholders pending Printful Store activation. Added TODO comment for Shades design once artwork is ready.

legal_and_regulatory.rationale: Same Printful dropshipping model as v1 and v2. No on-site payment processing. No PII collected. Modal is a UI-only change with no backend or data implications.

privacy_local_first_promise.rationale: Purely static HTML and vanilla JS. Modal state managed in-memory only. No cookies, no tracking pixels, no new analytics added.
evidence: All state in JS closure variables

medical_scope_and_claims.rationale: Merch page. No health claims. All taglines are identity-affirming humor, not clinical language.
evidence: Design taglines reviewed — no medical framing

behavioral_science_alignment.rationale: Modal replaces a 30-card scroll wall with a cleaner browse-then-pick flow. Reduces cognitive load. No countdown timers, no scarcity messaging, no urgency pressure.
evidence: No dark patterns in product picker

neurodivergence_research_alignment.rationale: Design-first grid is more scannable and less overwhelming than 30 individual product cards. Modal allows focused decision-making on one design at a time. Color palette unchanged. No new animations beyond subtle modal entrance.
evidence: Modal backdrop blur reduces background noise
Animation is simple opacity+translate, no looping or flashing

user_benefit_and_harm_check.rationale: UX improvement — fewer cards to scan, clearer path to purchase. Foreseeable harm: none beyond existing risk of a customer not liking a product.
evidence: Removed redundant cards reduces page scroll length by ~70%
Modal provides immediate product comparison by price
All purchases optional, no psychological coercion

brand_voice_and_claims.rationale: New design taglines reviewed for Takota voice: blunt, grounded, no wellness fluff. No superlatives or false product claims. Starting price shown accurately.
evidence: From-price is lowest actual product price in data

accessibility_and_inclusion.rationale: Design cards have tabindex=0, keyboard Enter/Space activation, and descriptive aria-labels. Modal has role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby wired to heading, focus trap, ESC key close, and focus restoration on close. All images have alt text. Color contrast unchanged (gold on near-black, WCAG AA).
evidence: Focus trap implemented in modal keydown handler

security_and_reliability.rationale: All dynamic HTML constructed via textContent / escHtml() helper — no raw innerHTML with user-controlled strings. Design data is hardcoded in the script. No new attack surface.
evidence: escHtml() escapes &, <, >, " for all data interpolated into HTML

monetization_and_dark_pattern_check.rationale: Prices visible in modal before any click-through. No upsells, no urgency copy, no forced account creation. Product picker is neutral — no default selection, no pre-checked options.
evidence: All prices shown in modal product rows
Buy buttons open Printful in new tab
No auto-close timers or pressure mechanisms

ship_decision.conditions: All filters clear. Outstanding post-ship actions: (1) Replace all href='#' buy buttons with real Printful Store URLs once store is enabled. (2) Add Shades design entry in DESIGNS array once artwork file is delivered and placed in /assets/merch/.
